name: Pagination
intent: The bar under a long table that moves between pages, says which rows are showing, and lets people pick how many rows a page holds.
usage: Use Pagination under a Table or DataGrid whose rows don't fit on one page. It is one component: pass total (the number of rows) and read page and pageSize back to slice your rows. Previous and next arrows sit at the start with the page numbers between them; long runs collapse into an ellipsis around the current page. At the end, Showing 1 to 10 of 59 rows and a kit Select to pick 10, 25, 50 or 100 rows per page. Changing the page size keeps the first visible row on screen. See contracts/pagination.json for the full contract.

total.note: How many rows there are in all.

defaultPage.note: Starting page when page is not controlled.

defaultPageSize.note: Starting rows per page when pageSize is not controlled.

onPageSizeChange.note: (pageSize: number) => void. The page moves so the first row that was showing stays in view.

pageSizes.note: The choices in the rows per page Select.

showRange.note: The Showing 1 to 10 of 59 rows text.

label.note: Names the page navigation for screen readers.

useWhen: Under a Table or DataGrid with more rows than fit on one page.
Lists people move through page by page and may want longer pages for.
doNot: Do not use it to switch views or steps. Use Tabs.
Do not build page buttons from a ButtonGroup or loose Buttons. Use Pagination.
Do not invent a PageSizeSelect or RowsInfo. Turn showPageSize and showRange on or off.
a11y: A nav named by label holds the arrows and page buttons.
Page buttons are named Page 3; the current one has aria-current page. The ellipsis is hidden from screen readers.
The arrows are kit Buttons named Previous page and Next page, disabled on the first and last page.
The rows per page Select is named Rows per page, and the range text is a polite live region, so a change is read out.

examples.title: Rows and page size
examples.usage: 59 rows, 10 per page. Pick another page size from the Select; the current rows stay in view.

examples.title: Many pages
examples.usage: With 500 rows, the page numbers collapse into an ellipsis around the current page.

examples.title: Pages only
examples.usage: Without the range text or the Select, only the page navigation.
